relationships.subject: 15d-PGJ2

relationships.subject: GW9662
relationships.evidence_quote: intramuscular administration of GW9662 prevented the anti-hyperalgesic effect of 15d-PGJ2

relationships.subject: naloxone

key_findings: Intramuscular 15d-PGJ2 dose-dependently prevents carrageenan muscle hyperalgesia via PPARγ and opioid receptor-dependent mechanisms.
